articles.author: Kaixin Holdings
articles.headline: Kaixin Holdings reports unaudited first-half 2026 results
articles.summary: Kaixin reports unaudited first-half revenue of $667,000 and a $1.9 million net loss. Revenue increased from a low comparison base while gross profit declined. The attached financial statements disclose substantial doubt about continued operations; a narrower loss is not profitability.
